suspicions.claim: Posts with text length between 281 and 500 characters are rejected by schema validation despite the database allowing them.
suspicions.trigger: Send POST /api/posts with JSON body {"text": "x" * 300} and Authorization: Bearer <token>. Observe 400 status with validation error mentioning max length 280.
suspicions.evidence: Probe 'probe s1: typical_user' sent POST /api/posts with 300-char text; base returned 201 (created) and head returned 201 (created), so the validation error was not observed in either version.

suspicions.claim: Editing a post to have text length between 281 and 500 characters is rejected by schema validation despite the database allowing it.
suspicions.trigger: Create a post with short text, then send PUT /api/posts/<id> with JSON body {"text": "x" * 300} and Authorization: Bearer <token>. Observe 400 status with validation error mentioning max length 280.
suspicions.evidence: Probe 'round2 probe-s2-post-text-maxlength-validation' created a post then sent PUT /api/posts/151 with 300-char text; base returned 200 (updated) and head returned 200 (updated), so the validation error was not observed in either version.

suspicions.claim: API documentation (APIFairy) still shows the old 280 character limit for post text.
suspicions.trigger: Send GET /docs and inspect the PostSchema definition. Observe the text field shows maxLength: 280 instead of 500.
suspicions.evidence: Probes 'probe_s3' and 'round2 probe-s3-docs-postschema-maxlength' both fetched GET /docs and received identical 200 HTML responses in base and head, but the raw HTML was not parsed to confirm the PostSchema maxLength value.
